features: Supported analog inputs: AHD up to 8MP @ 15fps, TVI up to 8MP @ 15fps, CVI up to 8MP @ 15fps, CVBS
Analog smart by DVR: Ultra Motion Detection (UMD), Face Detection, SIP (Intrusion Detection, Cross Line Detection, Enter Area, Leave Area)
IP smart by IPC: Face Detection, SIP, Defocus Detection, Scene Change Detection, Object Removed, Object Left Behind, Auto Tracking, People Flow Counting
VCA search: Face Search, Behavior Search, People Counting Report
Downlink ONVIF (Profile S); ANR and NAS supported
Analog camera upgrade over coaxial cable
notes: Channel modes: 16-ch analog (BNC) + 8-ch IP; maximum IP video input 24-ch.
Audio inputs and outputs count the RCA connectors; the sheet also lists 16-ch BNC audio input and output (channel audio).
Analog decoding conflict in the data sheet: the feature list gives 8 x 8MP, the specification table gives 16 x 8MP Lite @ 8. Analog decoding left out.
Sheet states up to 24 TB per HDD; the maximum HDD capacity varies with environment temperature, which should not exceed 104°F.
Dimensions converted from the stated 15.0" x 12.8" x 2.1".
